mentions.name: freefall_800
mentions.description: Open source replacement control firmware for Masterbuilt Gravity series electronically controlled charcoal smokers, reverse engineered from the stock control PCB and rebuilt from scratch. Basic functionality is working with a fully local control web app, plus an Android app and Home Assistant integration. Ongoing work includes interface refinements and more advanced control sequencing features.
mentions.problem: The smoker hardware is good, but like most IoT devices, the stock firmware and app are poor.
